name: PubMedQA
description: A biomedical yes/no question-answering dataset with 1,000 expert-annotated questions and about 211,000 artificially generated questions, based on terms and information from PubMed abstracts. No data is vendored here.
citation: PubMedQA: A Dataset for Biomedical Research Question Answering. Jin et al. (2019). Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence.
